findings.description: Direct inspection of all six current V200 pose renders: crouch lifts the front skirt into a sharply folded wedge and exposes most of both upper thighs; sit opens the front panels around the thighs and exposes the underlayer. The merged continuous panels remove isolated center-lap pieces in neutral, but do not maintain coverage in these required poses.

The five current V200 views show a broad, nearly uniform A-line apron shape. Surface folds are densely crushed and irregular instead of reading as deliberate, separated pleats; the central join and hem do not establish the intended short pleated silhouette.
Current left and right V200 renders still show narrow panel portions projecting well past the otherwise level side hem, producing a long pointed tail on one side and an abrupt taper on the other.
Front, back, side, and three-quarter images retain visibly angular torso patches and a lumpy, uneven jacket-to-waist transition.

nextAction: Keep V200 rejected and preserve its new continuous-panel topology and passing manufacturing evidence. For V201, adjust the panel flare and skirt-body shaping so the front hem remains close to its neutral silhouette in crouch and sit, then rebuild and inspect all five views and six poses. Reduce the broad apron read by authoring deliberate, evenly spaced pleat channels and smoother waist attachment; remove side projections without shortening the required neutral coverage. Do not promote a package: avatar fit, rig/weights, Unity/VRChat runtime, UV, and release remain unverified.
